cases.title: T1 creates the invocation with its rows in one commit
cases.when: A task tool is called with a business key, and an ASK tool without one
then: Invocation, task, business-key and approval rows exist exactly as T1 lists
CreateTaskResult is sent only after the commit

cases.title: T2 approval queues the invocation in one transaction
cases.when: An approver approves all obligations
then: Approval APPROVED and invocation QUEUED in one commit

cases.title: T3 deny cancels and rejects the key
cases.when: An approver denies, then another approval is revoked
then: Invocation CANCELLED, task REJECTED, business-key outcome REJECTED

cases.title: T4 reserve consumes the approval once and mints the permit
cases.when: Two reserve calls race for one approved invocation
then: One nonce row and one permit; the other gets the same state back or a refusal

cases.title: T5 consume starts the lease and returns the fencing token
cases.when: The host in aud consumes the permit
then: lease_holder and lease_expires_at set; fencingToken equals the nonce

cases.title: T6 heartbeats renew the lease within the deadline
cases.when: The host heartbeats every lease/3 past the deadline
then: lease_expires_at never exceeds deadline + 5 s
A TERMINATE kill stops renewal

cases.title: T7 enters and leaves INPUT_REQUIRED
cases.when: The host sends inputRequest, then the Gateway posts input with the owner digest
then: task_input_deadline_at is set then cleared; the next LeaseRenewal carries inputResponses
A wrong owner digest gets not found

cases.title: T8 cancel invalidates the fencing token
cases.when: tasks/cancel arrives for QUEUED, PENDING_APPROVAL and EXECUTING invocations
then: QUEUED and PENDING_APPROVAL go to CANCELLED
EXECUTING goes to CANCEL_REQUESTED; secret delivery and broker checks fail; the next heartbeat returns cancelRequested

cases.title: T9 result commits terminal state, result, key outcome and outbox
cases.when: The host reports a result with a valid token, then repeats it
then: One terminal transition; the repeat is a no-op
A result above 64 KiB lands in control_invocation_results

cases.title: T10 executor notStarted cannot authorize rebinding
cases.when: The host reports FAILED with notStarted after a spool failure, with and without an independently complete Control no-write journal
then: The worker flag is retained only as reported evidence and supplies no recovery proof
Rebinding requires current authority, the original operation deadline and Control's complete never-consumed or independently qualified broker-no-write proof; ambiguous work remains fenced

cases.title: T11 lease expiry preserves consumed ambiguity
cases.when: Leases expire for consumed and never-consumed attempts, including tools labelled idempotent or non-ledger
then: Consumed work remains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN unless independent scope and every effect generation establish a resolved outcome
Tool labels and attempt counts alone do not permit re-execution; positive no-write recovery retains the operation identity and original deadline

cases.title: T12 expiry before consumption
cases.when: An approval, a queued pickup and an input request each pass their deadline
then: EXPIRED; any nonce left unconsumed

cases.title: T13 late evidence contributes without overwriting another attempt
cases.when: A qualified late successful report arrives after expiry, then independent contradictory target evidence arrives
then: The executor/current-dispatch record is preserved; business finalization waits for all attempts, closed authority and resolved effects
Independent contradiction moves a final business outcome to RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED and fences new effects; no automatic retry

cases.title: T14 purge tombstones results without changing state
cases.when: retain_until passes
then: Payload replaced by tombstone; business-key row tombstoned; state unchanged

cases.title: A transition not in the table gets 409
cases.when: A host reports a result for a QUEUED invocation, and a heartbeat for a SUCCEEDED one
then: 409 each

cases.title: Control calls replay on Idempotency-Key
cases.when: Each caller endpoint is called twice with the same Idempotency-Key and the response is dropped the first time
then: The second call replays the first response; nothing is applied twice

cases.title: All recovery generations precede final success
cases.when: A qualified attempt releases one generation, recovers, completes its replacement and closes
then: RUNNING persists until worker closure; both attempts and generations remain in bounded history; a contradictory target report requires reconciliation

cases.title: A late successful report cannot resolve a pending write
cases.when: A qualified consumed attempt expires and reports success before its target outcome arrives
then: The operation stays unknown until the target witness; closure never reissues execution; history retains the old executor state separately

cases.title: Unqualified reported success is not business success
cases.when: An unqualified worker reports success and a qualified worker leaves a sent effect unresolved
then: Both operations remain OUTCOME_UNKNOWN

cases.title: A transport completion with an error is partial after a witnessed write
cases.when: A target confirms a write but the worker reports COMPLETED with an error result
then: The executor state is FAILED and the business outcome is PARTIAL

cases.title: Fresh caller metadata reads do not extend execution
cases.when: The execution deadline expires and the same currently authorized caller reads status and history
then: Retained failed metadata is readable with the original deadline; there is no recovery or replacement authority
